profile.name: Alessio Iodice
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer
profile.bio: Software engineer with 6+ years of experience in e-commerce and digital transformation, currently Senior Consultant and Tech Lead at Deloitte Digital. I design and build integrations between high-traffic B2C commerce platforms and the surrounding enterprise landscape — IAM, CRM, ERP, OMS and payment gateways — applying distributed systems patterns such as transactional outbox, dual-write with reconciliation, idempotent webhook handling and graceful degradation. I care about systems that stay correct under partial failure and remain maintainable over time.

experience.description: Technical lead on B2C e-commerce projects across the retail, home appliances and automotive sectors, built on Salesforce Commerce Cloud with Node.js and React.js.
highlights: Designed and implemented the order export flow to the OMS using a transactional outbox pattern, decoupling order capture from downstream delivery and guaranteeing eventual consistency under partial failure

Built CRM synchronisation as a dual-write with asynchronous reconciliation and a read-through cache, with explicit graceful degradation so checkout remains available when the external service is unreachable

Implemented payment gateway webhook handling with ack-on-receipt semantics to prevent head-of-line blocking, and specified the target asynchronous architecture with a dead-letter queue for failed events
Built batch ingestion pipelines for product catalogue data (PIM) via timestamped XML feeds, with validation and retry handling
Designed and troubleshot a layered CDN architecture (client-managed CDN in front of the platform CDN), including diagnosis of cache-related content visibility issues
Acted as the main technical point of contact with client architects and third-party vendors on integration design and failure-handling strategy
Mentored junior engineers, reviewed code and supported their technical growth
